title: Set ECall Config Request
description: Backs taf_ecall_UseUSimNumbers/SetPsapNumber (numType/overriddenNum), taf_ecall_SetNadClearDownFallbackTime (t2Timer), taf_ecall_SetNadMinNetworkRegistrationTime (t9Timer) -- all via ICallManager::setECallConfig(EcallConfig). 1:1 port of tel_simulation.proto's SetConfigRequest, including its is*Valid validity-mask booleans (EcallConfigType bitmask on the wire). Deliberately has no phoneId field -- the old proto's SetConfigRequest/GetConfig(google.protobuf.Empty) had none either; eCall config is global, not per-phone, unlike every other eCall RPC.
